caption.text:
Some people enter your life as lessons. Others enter your life as mirrors. One of the hardest truths to accept is that no amount of love, patience, or understanding can change someone who isn’t willing to change themselves. At some point, healing begins when you stop falling in love with potential and start paying attention to reality. 🖤

This page from ‘This Is How It Feels to Be Seen’ by Sophie Beatrice is a gentle reminder that protecting your peace is not giving up on someone—it is finally choosing yourself. Sometimes letting go isn’t about a lack of love. Sometimes it’s about recognizing that loving them is hurting you more than losing them. If you’re navigating heartbreak, learning to release someone who keeps disappointing you, healing from an unhealthy relationship, or trying to trust yourself again after being hurt, this book is filled with the kind of words that make you feel understood, seen, and a little less alone.
